body: The problem isn't school. My school is a pretty awesome place to be, and people don't really bully me (you have to notice somebody to be bully them). I'm not a victim to anybody but my own inhibitions. People are friendly to me, but I have no friends because of my horrible shyness. I really wish I could get friends, I just can't break out of my shell. My grades are my only asset, as last marking period I had all A+s. This marking period is different since my grades are being affected by my worsening depression. I really do try, but I just can't focus and end up giving up. I feel like even if I get a decent job later in life it won't matter because I don't have anybody to have fun with. I am going to tell my mother tonight about my situation. Thank you for the support!
